gallery.filename: The Illustrated London News Volume XLVIII News 16 June 1866 p 5 'Hampton Races - the ferry at Molesey'.png
gallery.title: File:The Illustrated London News Volume XLVIII News 16 June 1866 p 5 'Hampton Races - the ferry at Molesey'.png
gallery.source: Hampton Races, the Ferry at Moulsey
gallery.description:
Engraving of the Hampton Races, the Ferry at Moulsey. Illustration for The Illustrated London News, 16 June 1866, showing the ferry from Hampton to Molesey, with St Mary's Church, Garrick's Villa and Garrick's Temple, Hampton all in the background. Horse races were held at Hurst Park, Molesey, accessible by the ferry from Hampton.
The Hampton ferry has been operating since 1514 to the present day.

gallery.title: File:Hampton Thames boatyards 1928.png
gallery.description: Aerial photo of boatyards and riverside on the River Thames at Hampton, London taken 1 August 1928. Benn's Island appears lower left. The Bell Inn appears on Thames Street right of frame with the prominent white balcony, next to the graveyard of St Mary's Parish Church (out of frame).

gallery.title: File:Hampton April 1946.png
gallery.description: Aerial photo of Hampton taken 11 April 1946 showing Station Road with the Meux Cottages terrace leading to St Mary's Church, the Beveree (left of frame) and associated parkland, and Castle House (centre frame). Hurst Park Racecourse, Tagg's Island and Hampton Court Palace are top right of frame.
